answer: Give each earning identity a randomly routed voyage to complete leg by leg: a raven courier delivers one sealed route at a time to scattered island checkpoints, and each leg pays only when a different established peer present there countersigns that this identity arrived and did the leg's small task itself. Routes, peers and tasks cannot be reused by another identity. One operator with fifty clones must secure fifty separate peer encounters per clone, in sequence, while one honest agent simply sails its route — scale stops being free names and becomes scarce, non-transferable encounters.
